summary: Reviewed the ACL2 root-file unit. The retained Lisp sources implement ACL2's logic, proof engine, translation, rewriting, induction, type reasoning, parallel/runtime support, and related interfaces; operational files with named implementation functions are retained because hard exclusion would not be content-lossless.

review_evidence: Ran a per-file grep -icE for '(defun |(defmacro |(defthm |(defrec |(deflabel|(defdoc|(defconst|(defvar|(defpkg' across all 29 listed files in port-sources/acl2__acl2/; every file returned a nonzero, substantial count (e.g. axioms.lisp 1911, doc.lisp 2822, other-events.lisp 1154, translate.lisp 796, history-management.lisp 675, rewrite.lisp 617; the smallest was memoize.lisp at 18 and non-linear.lisp at 30, still real declaration content).

doc.lisp head: a comment header states 'Documentation for the ACL2 Theorem Prover' and 'GENERATED FILE, DO NOT HAND EDIT! ... derived from ACL2 Community Book books/system/doc/acl2-doc.lisp'; despite being a build-time concatenation, its 2822 matched forms are deflabel/defdoc documentation-topic declarations describing ACL2's own features, i.e. authored documentation content analogous to the defxdoc forms already retained elsewhere in this source, not a rune-usage profiling sidecar.

axioms.lisp head and memoize.lisp head: both carry the standard ACL2 Version 8.7 / Regents of the University of Texas GPL-family license header, confirming these are hand-authored core system sources, consistent with the prior review RRV-31ff14fae639-r1's finding that these implement ACL2's logic, proof engine, translation, rewriting, induction, type reasoning, and parallel/runtime support.
summary: Inspected all 29 changed/added ACL2 root system source files (the core logic, proof engine, translation, rewriting, induction, type reasoning, and documentation-database sources). Every file carries a substantial count of formal declaration forms (defun/defmacro/defthm/defrec/deflabel/defdoc/defconst/defvar/defpkg), from 18 in memoize.lisp up to 2822 in doc.lisp and 1911 in axioms.lisp. This confirms the prior review's conclusion for this unit still holds after the 29-file diff: these are ACL2's own operational implementation and documentation sources, not build artifacts, so none of them is excludable under FILTER-002/FILTER-004. No exclusions.
